fix(phase4a.1): timeouts + perf primary + synth timeout handling

**Fixes Phase 4 ensemble production failure** (1/15 fully-healthy verdicts in shadow).

## Root causes (from shadow telemetry analysis at `.claude/research/phase4b-shadow/`)

1. `deepseek-v4-pro:cloud` (logic) hits 90s wall on retries — 12/15 logic runs aborted
2. `kimi-k2.6:cloud` (synth) squeezed when specialist verdicts run long — 4/15 hit 240s outer timeout at 199-211s
3. `minimax-m2.1:cloud` (perf primary) unreliable — 6/12 successful runs came from `glm-5.1` fallback

## Patch

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| SPECIALIST_TIMEOUT_MS | 90s | 180s |
| SYNTHESIZER_TIMEOUT_MS | 120s | 180s |
| ORCHESTRATOR_TIMEOUT_MS | 240s | 400s |
| RESERVED_HEADROOM_MS | — | 40s |
| RETRIEVAL_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS | — | 15s |
| logic.retries | 2 | 1 |
| performance.primary | minimax-m2.1:cloud | glm-5.1:cloud |
| performance.fallback | glm-5.1:cloud | kimi-k2.5:cloud |

Plus structural changes:
- Static budget invariant enforced at module load (`specialist + synth + headroom ≤ orch`)
- Pre-flight retrieval wrapped in `withComposedTimeout(15s)`; failure → empty snapshot per v3.1 §8
- Synth call wrapped in try/catch that distinguishes synth-local timeout from outer-orch abort. Synth-local timeout writes `synthesizer.timedOut: true` + `fellBackReason: 'synth_timeout'` (was bubbling as `internalError: 'Operation aborted'`)

## Tests

481 → 489. New: timeout invariant, exact values, pre-flight slack, per-role lineup, max-calls-per-PR derivation (16, was 17).

## Sign-off

- Codex: 'ship with 3 changes' (synth timeout handling, math, tests) — integrated
- Kimi K2.6: 'ship with 1 tweak' (orch ≥ 390s) — integrated as 400s
